note: Replaces the WP48 re-run of final-910e6aa (verdict READY, 10/0/0/3) with the release measurement of the 0.3.0b1 candidate. LibreOffice, Word, gate and timing lanes: integration 71af76e, final_set.sh steps b,c,d,f on a clean detached worktree (strict gate PASS, 2067 tests). Docs lane: the live sweep flown on 410d370 = 71af76e + WP56 (a gdocs-profile-only change whose standard-profile word/*.xml was proven byte-identical over all 95 documents) + docs/images; the gdocs DOCX changes are release code, so the Docs lane is measured on the release's own gdocs output. beta_readiness was therefore run with --allow-mixed-commits (the Docs rows carry no commit of their own, so the scorecard recorded no mixed-commit finding to allow). Step g was run by hand because final_set.sh has no --allow-mixed-commits flag; its inputs are exactly final_set's. Serial timing: the first timings of y06, y18, y47 (and an orphaned process's y12) started while the live Docs sweep loaded the host; all were superseded and re-timed after it finished, each after its own 60 s quiet window (RETIMED.md, input retimed_note). CI on 410d370: workflow 'gate' green (runs 38153277261 and 38144239322); workflow 'install' (install + smoke, all platforms) failed: four test modules (test_harness_baseline, _invisible_marks, _reading, _tracking) import fitz, which that job does not install, and on Windows test_batch_scan's casefold test trips on the runner's 8.3 temp path (run 38153277268). Verdict READY (10 pass, 0 fail, 0 unmeasured, 3 reported); criterion 12 passes and flags nothing: it reads the README's cited evidence files (2 cited, 2 dated), not the prose numbers, so the older Docs figures the README quotes (y58 Docs pages 4, now 3 of a 2-page source; y06 Docs pages 154, now 155 of 126) are not checked by it; the README update is a separate task.
